messages:
Evan Park: hi folks, accepted the GitHub invite but it says 'Invitation pending' in the org page and I can't access any private repos. my GitHub account email is evpark@gmail.com but my work email is evan.park@redwood.com. could that be the problem?

onboarding-bot: welcome Evan! :wave: If your GitHub account email doesn't match the invite target, the invite may be tied to the work email. Try adding your work email to GitHub and verify it. Docs: https://docs.redwood.example/devex/github-invite

Lina: @Evan Park yep, invites go to the target email. If you add evan.park@redwood.com to your GitHub and verify it, the invite should attach. Alternatively, we can re-send to your primary GitHub email. Which do you prefer?

Evan Park: i'll add the work email. doing that now.

IT-Raj: FYI sometimes corporate SSO is enforced and the invite needs SAML authorization after email match. If you still see pending after adding email, ping me and I'll check IdP logs.

Evan Park: added evan.park@redwood.com and verified. the org page still shows 'Invitation pending' though.

Lina: hm, did you accept the invite link in that email? sometimes people verify the email but forget to click the invite URL. check your inbox for an email from GitHub with subject "You’ve been invited to join the redwood-inference organization".

Evan Park: found it in spam folder :facepalm: clicked accept, now it shows me as a member. thanks.

Ben: added you to team eng-platform (write) and repos: platform-api (write), infra-scripts (read). Should propagate in a couple minutes.

Evan Park: I can see platform-api but trying to clone gives 403: "remote: Repository not found."

QA-Aya: 403 after team adds usually means SSO needed. Go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference and authorize SAML if prompted. If no banner, @IT-Raj might need to trigger IdP invite.

Evan Park: I clicked the org page and it asked me to authorize SSO, did that. git clone now works. thanks everyone.

IT-Raj: created ticket IT-834 to note the email/spam issue for People Ops onboarding checklist. We'll add a step to tell new hires to check spam and add work email before clicking invite.

Evan Park: great, one last question: where do I request repo access for demo datasets repo?

Lina: open an access request in the onboarding tracker or DM me and I'll add you to eng-data. Welcome aboard! :tada:
